// Standalone repro page for weather-pin flicker: bare-bones deck.gl attribute // transitions, no MapLibre. Minimal case: ScatterplotLayer/IconLayer + a single // getFillColor/getColor transition + static data. deck.gl/@deck.gl/core@9.3.6. import { Deck } from '@deck.gl/core'; import { IconLayer, ScatterplotLayer } from '@deck.gl/layers'; const PIN_RADIUS_PX = 13; const ICON_MAPPING = { dot: { x: 0, y: 0, width: PIN_RADIUS_PX * 2, height: PIN_RADIUS_PX * 2, anchorX: PIN_RADIUS_PX, anchorY: PIN_RADIUS_PX, mask: true } }; function buildIconAtlas() { const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = PIN_RADIUS_PX * 2; canvas.height = PIN_RADIUS_PX * 2; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(PIN_RADIUS_PX, PIN_RADIUS_PX, PIN_RADIUS_PX, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); return canvas; } const ICON_ATLAS = buildIconAtlas(); const CENTER = [174.8, -36.85]; const N_PINS = 40; const stations = []; for (let i = 0; i < N_PINS; i++) { stations.push({ position: [CENTER[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, CENTER[1] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3], color: [Math.floor(Math.random() * 255), Math.floor(Math.random() * 200), 80, 180] }); } let useTransitions = true; let useIconLayer = false; let dataVersion = 0; function randomColor() { return [Math.floor(Math.random() * 255), Math.floor(Math.random() * 200), 80, 180]; } function shuffleColors() { for (const s of stations) s.color = randomColor(); dataVersion++; redraw(); } function makeLayer() { if (useIconLayer) { return new IconLayer({ id: 'test-icon', data: stations, iconAtlas: ICON_ATLAS, iconMapping: ICON_MAPPING, sizeUnits: 'pixels', transitions: useTransitions ? { getColor: 300 } : undefined, getPosition: d => d.position, getIcon: () => 'dot', getSize: PIN_RADIUS_PX * 2, getColor: d => d.color, updateTriggers: { getColor: dataVersion } }); } return new ScatterplotLayer({ id: 'test-scatter', data: stations, radiusUnits: 'pixels', transitions: useTransitions ? { getFillColor: 300 } : undefined, getPosition: d => d.position, getRadius: PIN_RADIUS_PX, getFillColor: d => d.color, updateTriggers: { getFillColor: dataVersion } }); } const deck = new Deck({ parent: document.getElementById('deck-container'), initialViewState: { longitude: CENTER[0], latitude: CENTER[1], zoom: 10 }, controller: true, layers: [makeLayer()] }); function redraw() { deck.setProps({ layers: [makeLayer()] }); } document.getElementById('chk-transitions').addEventListener('change', e => { useTransitions = e.target.checked; redraw(); }); document.getElementById('chk-icon').addEventListener('change', e => { useIconLayer = e.target.checked; redraw(); }); document.getElementById('btn-shuffle').addEventListener('click', shuffleColors); let autoTimer = null; document.getElementById('chk-auto').addEventListener('change', e => { if (e.target.checked) autoTimer = setInterval(shuffleColors, 2000); else { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; } }); const gl = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl2'); const dbg = gl?.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info'); document.getElementById('gl-info').textContent = dbg ? gl.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) : 'renderer info unavailable';
